explanation: The main character in the book, a Jewish woman who becomes queen of Persia and saves her people from destruction.
The king of Persia who is married to Esther and plays a central role in the story.
Esther's older cousin and guardian, who discovers a conspiracy against King Xerxes and helps Esther save the Jews.
A high official in the Persian empire who plans to destroy the Jews, but ultimately falls victim to his own evil schemes.
A Jewish festival that celebrates the deliverance of the Jews in Persia, established after the events in the book of Esther.
A period during which Esther and the Jews fast and pray for God to intervene and save them from Haman's wicked plans.
An instrument that Haman builds to hang Mordecai, but on which he himself ends up being hanged after his evil schemes are exposed.
